name: zbuild
description: Plugin-based framework for autonomous AI agent delivery pipelines.
author: Eric Ziegler <eric@zig.us>

scripts.lint: count=$(grep -rEn 'claude-haiku|claude-sonnet|claude-opus|gpt-[0-9]|llama-[0-9]|mistral-' core/ plugins/ scripts/ --include='*.sh' --include='*.yaml' --include='*.json' --exclude-dir='.git' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [[ "$count" -gt 0 ]]; then echo "ERROR: $count hardcoded model name(s) found (ADR-003 violation)"; exit 1; fi && shellcheck -x --severity=warning scripts/zbuild && find scripts core plugins -name '*.sh' -not -path '*/legacy/*' -print0 | xargs -0 shellcheck -x --severity=warning && bash scripts/lib/lint-stage-io.sh && bash scripts/lib/lint-contract.sh && bash scripts/lib/lint-doc-style.sh && bash scripts/lib/lint-vision.sh && bash scripts/lib/validate-mechanics-yaml.sh && bash scripts/lib/lint-doc-freshness.sh && bash scripts/lib/lint-action-versions.sh
